Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly interpreted the search results from the WebSurfer. In Step 3, the WebSurfer retrieved a BBC History search result which clearly stated "Alexander the Great dies | June 11, 323 B.C." and other sources consistently cited 323 BCE. However, in Step 4, the Planner arbitrarily introduced an astronomical calendar conversion (claiming 323/322 BCE aligns to 322 BCE) without any evidence from the retrieved sources supporting this shift. This led to the final answer of 322 BCE, which contradicts the overwhelming consensus in the cited sources (Britannica, History.com, World History Encyclopedia, and BBC) that the death occurred in 323 BCE.
